text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 40, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "40 years"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 50000, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "$50,000/year"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 20, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "after 20 years"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 5, "unit": "%", "kind": "count", "span": "5% of the value"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 30, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "after 30 years"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q5", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "years of eligibility earned beyond the 20-year threshold"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "cumulative percent of the full pension earned"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s3", "note": "helper: 20*5 = 100, to turn the percent into a fraction"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "full pension times the cumulative percent number"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s4", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "annual pension at year 30 = full pension * (percent/100)"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "Marcy's annual pension if she quits after 30 years"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 40, "reason": "the 40-year full-career figure only establishes the pension schedule; once the 20-year start point and the 30-year quit point are known it is not needed for the calculation"}]}
